title: Antique Pewter Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Allied Brass
description: Shower basket for bathroom shower storage, 18 in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. 75 inches long (18.75-inch, 18.75 in) with wall mount / wall-mounted installation and concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look. This oval combination shower basket (shower caddy / shower basket organizer) is made from solid brass with rust proof solid brass wires and ventilated heavy-gauge wire construction to allow drainage. Traditional style fits traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Designer finish is specified for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Includes basket and all installation hardware; assembly required: false. Dimensions: 18.75 L x 2.25 H x 4.13 W in; projection 4.13 in. Product weight 4.8 lb. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
